name: Effect: Bully the Bully (Critical Success)

source.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies

text: Augsten is cut deep by your teasing! He becomes Stunned 1 by his rage, and is Off-Guard to your attacks for the next 24 hours. During this time, he takes a –4 circumstance penalty to all attempts to use demoralize on any target, and can't use Bullying Command.
